prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A simple crown-like form — three rounded points over a horizontal band,
reduced to essential silhouette.
formatted_prompt: Flat bold app icon centered on an off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding. A single crown silhouette — three smooth rounded points rising from a solid horizontal band — rendered in burnt-orange (#D97742) as the primary fill, with a deep crimson (#B04646) interior band stripe as the sole secondary detail. Adult anatomical proportions irrelevant here; every edge is sharp crisp vector geometry. No gradients, no textures, no brushwork, no ornamentation beyond the three-point crown form. Flat material-symbols-fill register, fully readable at 16px. Clean 2026-era UI iconography on a pale neutral ground, high contrast against the dark secondary tones.
